findings.title: Status page claims committed per-phase review evidence that the SDK report says is still pending
findings.message: The status page says every phase has a committed Prism review and verification record, and lists the private SDK as implemented. The new SDK release report contradicts this. It says the archive is a dirty precommit snapshot, that the final archive will be regenerated after the phase commits, and that its records do not replace final clean-HEAD or phase commit evidence. Stating that committed evidence exists overstates the acceptance state of the SDK phase.
findings.suggestion: Reword to say review and verification records exist, with the SDK phase's committed clean-HEAD archive evidence still pending. Alternatively, drop the claim until that evidence is committed. Also link the SDK release report from the SDK item.

findings.title: `archive_trusted: true` conflicts with the self-attested, unverified authenticity status
findings.message: The report sets `archive_trusted: true`, but the same file says `independent_authenticity_verified: false`, and the sibling reports say `digest_trust: local-producer-self-attested`. The expected digest came from the same local producer, so the archive was only integrity-checked against itself. A consumer reading the boolean alone could take it as authenticity, which contradicts the scoped trust model in the release spec.
findings.suggestion: Rename or replace the field so it cannot be read as authenticity, for example `digest_verified_against_expected: true` plus `digest_trust: local-producer-self-attested`. Or set `archive_trusted` to false unless an independent trust channel was used. Make the relocated-consumer producer and any readers consistent.
